scope: Bounded isolated implementation complete; integration and visual/browser verification remain lead-owned.
changes: Added publicTrust(svc, slug, at) service with one supplied evaluation instant, workspace-locked metadata snapshot, shared core scoreOf/effectiveEvidenceState basis, published enabled framework selection and canonical framework ordering.

Public percentages expose numerator/denominator, in-scope/excluded/upcoming counts, catalog/formula versions and calculation explanations; empty denominators return null instead of implying a measured percentage.
Added latestMonitoringChecks(checks, at): latest observed result per connector/check/recorded configuration, excluding invalid/future observations, with deterministic equal-time ID tie-breaking.
Public and authorized private checks routes now load all saved check history before selecting latest sources; results older than 100/200 newer records are retained.

Public monitoring uses stable workspace-scoped opaque IDs and distinct target/configuration labels, preserving title/outcome/time while excluding raw configuration hashes, addresses, connector names, observed payloads and evidence details.
Public headline identifies organization-authored text explicitly; generated default is marked template. ReportsPage explains publication accurately.
Private EvidencePage preserves and labels recorded configurations and observation age separately from current connector settings.

corrected_failures.finding: Initial private-route test received 401 because fake test time exceeded the login session lifetime.
corrected_failures.resolution: Renew test login after setting the supplied fake clock; private-route 207-record regression then passed.

corrected_failures.finding: Lead concurrent integration run found public framework order differed from existing summary order.
corrected_failures.resolution: Reuse FRAMEWORK_ORDER; existing targeted publication-choice/order test now passes without weakening assertions.

contracts.publicTrust: publicTrust(svc: VisuaService, slug: string, at = new Date()) reads only a slug-matched public workspace; returns asOf, headlineSource, shared basis explanations, frameworks with nullable percentage and denominator/scope basis, policy titles/versions and privacy-filtered monitoring.
contracts.latestMonitoringChecks: latestMonitoringChecks(checks: readonly CheckResult[], at = new Date()) -> CheckResult[]. Key is JSON.stringify([connectorId,checkId,source?.configHash??null]); select greatest observedAt, tie greatest id; observations after at are excluded.
contracts.private_route_change: GET /api/workspaces/:ws/checks now returns one full authorized CheckResult per recorded source/configuration/check instead of at most 200 recent history rows. Existing /checks/:id still retrieves an individual historical observation.
contracts.public_privacy: Public target/configuration labels and row IDs are SHA-256-derived from workspace plus recorded source identities; raw config hashes, addresses, connector names, observation detail/payloads, requirement IDs and evidence bodies are not returned.
contracts.evidence_basis: Each scoped requirement is covered iff shared effectiveEvidenceState(item, allMetadata, at, requirementId).status is valid for an attached artifact. Readiness comes from existing svc.scoreOf(index, sameInput, sameAt).
contracts.scope: Framework measures honor enabled/published selection and exclude threats; laws remain opt-in and distinguish upcoming/in-force/ended dates. Existing public policy-title and monitoring publication scope is preserved and described separately from framework measure selection.

ownership_expansions: Root explicitly authorized private /api/workspaces/:ws/checks full-list + shared latest selection beyond original public-route-only app.ts ownership.
Root explicitly authorized narrow EvidencePage recorded configuration/time labels and separation from current settings beyond latestChecks selection.
known_limits: The supplied asOf evaluates current recorded metadata; it does not reconstruct earlier edits or decisions. UI and API basis explicitly say so.
Legacy checks without a recorded configHash cannot reconstruct former target/configuration identity; they remain a separate 'Configuration not recorded' series per connector/check.

All-history latest selection scans saved checks through the existing collection API. The >200 regression proves correctness, not production-scale capacity; no database schema/query optimization was in scope.

Framework readiness/evidence measures honor publication choices. Existing publication of approved/published policy titles and recorded monitoring outcomes remains workspace-wide; no new raw data disclosure was added.
Public monitoring distinguishes opaque recorded sources but intentionally does not disclose actual target addresses or connector/configuration details.
No browser server, build or visual inspection was run under this bounded brief. Lead should verify TrustPage expanded calculation details and EvidencePage source labels at desktop/phone sizes.
No core shared type or previous corpus-lane source paths were edited.
integration_remaining: Lead visual/browser verification of public trust and private evidence pages
